## About
Imported Motor Cars is Pete Oraha's shop in Santee. Pete grew up in Northern Iraq, where his father taught him the value of hard work, keeping your word and being faithful to the people you serve. After coming to the United States, he earned a degree in automotive mechanics from the Lincoln Institute of Automotive Technology and built a successful auto services business in central Chicago.
Pete later moved to the San Diego area for the same reason most of us live here: the weather. Before Santee, the shop was known as Automotive Work Tech in Poway. His certificates for technical certifications and continuing education hang on the shop walls.
Whether you drive a fine Japanese car, a luxury import, a classic or something exotic, Pete works on it himself, explains what he finds and follows up on the work.

## Services
- Complete auto electric: Diagnosis and repair of electrical failures, including battery and charging systems, lights, power windows, power seats and sun-roofs.
- Computerized engine diagnostics and tune-up: Today's cars are computer controlled, so we use current diagnostic hardware and software to find out what failed and why.
- Brake services, including ABS: ABS and traction controls are computer monitored, so we use electronic diagnosis to find the problem and fix it accurately.
- Transmission services: Regular checks of transmission fluids and electronic solenoids to catch problems before they leave you stranded.
- Emission services: California's smog check standards are high. We look for exhaust, tune-up and emission problems ahead of your smog check.
- Steering and axle work: Steering, wheel alignment, rear axle and differential work, the parts that are easy to forget until they fail.
- Exotic car specialists: Whether your car is exotic or just old, we can restore it or keep it in mint condition, mechanically and electrically.

## FAQ
Q: Where is the shop?
A: We're on Woodside Ave in Santee, the east side frontage road off Hwy 67, between the Mission Gorge and Riverford Rd. exits.

Q: Do I need an appointment?
A: You can call Pete to set up a service appointment, or just stop by the shop.

Q: Do you work on older or exotic cars?
A: Yes. Whether your car is exotic or just old, Pete can restore it or keep it running in mint condition.

Q: What if I don't see the service I need?
A: Just ask. The list on this page isn't everything we do.
